    page_index += 1

print('note ids/titles:', [(n['note_id'], n['title']) for n in all_notes])

# Update the bucket list item from [ ] to [x]
old_line = "[ ] Learning to cook a signature dish from scratch"
new_line = "[x] Learning to cook a signature dish from scratch"
content = note['content']
if old_line not in content:
    raise ValueError('Target line not found in note content')
new_content = content.replace(old_line, new_line)
print('Replaced:', old_line, '->', new_line)

resp = apis.simple_note.update_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=access_token, content=new_content)
print('update_note response:', resp)

# Verify
note_after = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=access_token)
print('After content snippet:')
for line in note_after['content'].splitlines():
    if 'Learning to cook a signature dish from scratch' in line:
        print(line)
